layout.spatial_order: CLIP Conv2d -> flatten(2).transpose(1,2), row-major; prefix CLS excluded; coordinates refer to padded/resized model input

latency.scope: One Tower call encodes all six views. Do not multiply by six.
latency.hardware_identity_limit: E1 recorded GPU model and device ordinal, not GPU serial/UUID; comparison is at that recorded granularity.

definitions.cosine: 1 - cosine(F_t[u], F_previous[u]); fp32 arithmetic on real fp16 model output, clipped to [0,2]
definitions.normalized_l2: L2 distance of individually unit-normalized tokens; equals sqrt(2*cosine) up to roundoff
definitions.stable: cosine distance <= threshold; all configured thresholds reported
definitions.topk: sum of largest ceil(N*k) distances / total distance; zero-total contribution defined as 0
definitions.gini: 2*sum(i*d_sorted_i)/(N*sum(d))-(N+1)/N; zero-total Gini=0; measures unequal magnitude, not spatial adjacency
definitions.summary: Compute metrics within each pair; mean pairs within scene, then equal-weight scenes. Median/P90/P95 summaries are averages of per-pair token quantiles, not pooled token quantiles.
definitions.ci: 95% percentile bootstrap of scene means; no CI with fewer than 2 scenes; pointwise intervals for CDF/threshold curves, not simultaneous bands
definitions.cdf: Pair token empirical CDF -> within-scene mean -> equal-scene mean and bootstrap
definitions.coordinates: Corresponding model input patch positions; padded input regions remain part of the actual Tower grid; no physical motion compensation
definitions.content_sensitivity: Auxiliary subset: patches with >=50% geometric overlap with real image pixels in BOTH endpoints after original expand2square; interpolation at boundaries ignored. No input or model changes. Fully padded subset has zero overlap at both endpoints. Attention can propagate content into padded tokens.
definitions.opportunity: Stable tokens describe theoretical reuse opportunity only; no mapping to saved FLOPs or measured latency/speedup.
